ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from creating opportunities in stage 6 - Setup or 7 - Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'SBQQ__Quote__c'))),ISNEW() && (ISPICKVAL( StageName , '6 - Setup') || ISPICKVAL( StageName , '7 - Closed')) && RecordType.DeveloperName <> $Label.QTB_Billing_Opportunity_Record_Type )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create an opportunity at Stage 6 - Setup or 7 - Closed. Please select another opportunity stage
